title: chaenorhinum origanifolium var. degenii
intro: Chaenorhinum origanifolium var. degenii, commonly known as Hungarian chamomile, is a plant species within the Plantaginaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic actions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, calm nervousness, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Hungarian chamomile include apigenin, luteolin, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
